import psycopg2

def insert_employee(name, email, department):
    """Insert a new employee record into the database."""
    conn = psycopg2.connect(
        host="localhost",
        database="hr_db",
        user="hr_user",
        password="hr_pass_123"
    )
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Build and execute the insert query
    query = f"INSERT INTO employees (name, email, department) VALUES ('{name}', '{email}', '{department}')"
    cursor.execute(query)
    conn.commit()
    
    cursor.close()
    conn.close()
    return True

# Example usage
insert_employee('John Smith', 'john@company.com', 'Engineering')
